jess_procure: Heads up — vendor_flux pushed a revised ETA for our H100 allocation. Original ship was 3/12, new window 3/22–3/26. Carrier flagged possible customs inspection in FRA. Can we confirm holdback policy and whether we should convert sea->air for the 12 priority units? @liam_logistics @mike_ops

vendor_flux: Sorry for the churn — freight got rebooked. We can hold 12 units in our FRA pool and do air uplift for 4 units next-day at +$6k/unit, or air for all 12 at +$18k/unit. Sea ETA for remainder 10–14 days. AWBs: `FLX123456789`, `FLX987654321`.

liam_logistics: If we uplift 4, which serials will they be? Need RMA flow for any DOA returns. Prefer uplift of 4 QA pool units so we can validate ASAP. @david_infra can you confirm depot capacity?

david_infra: Can accept 4 next week but depot limited Mon–Wed. If units arrive early we need to tag them `reserved:holdback` in inventory so autoscheduler doesn't assign them to clusters. mike_ops, please add to provisioning queue and block auto-assign.

mike_ops: Added to queue `prov-4721`. I'll set a staging hold and notification to infra when items are scanned. Also note: any RMA needs consolidated AWB + customs invoice to avoid brokerage delays — vendor, can you provide that?

vendor_flux: Yes — we can issue consolidated proforma and manifest. For RMA pre-auth we'll reference `RMA-8341` (provisionally covering the 12 units). Per our warranty, DOA within 14 days = cross-ship. We'll attach courier manifest once uplift scheduled.

jess_procure: Tradeoffs: cost vs backlog. I prefer air for 4 (QA) + sea for the remaining 8. vendor_flux, confirm PO amendment and whether you'll cover brokerage fees if the delay was paperwork-related.

vendor_flux: Confirmed air 4 / sea 8. PO amendment `AMEND-5021` shows +$24k for the 4 air units (total inc taxes). We'll waive brokerage if delay was due to our documentation. I'll DM the updated manifest to @liam_logistics once ready. ETA for air pickup: 48 hrs after your approval.

rma_bot: RMA created: `RMA-8341` (12 units). Please attach serial list: `S-HP100-001, S-HP100-002, S-HP100-003, S-HP100-004, S-HP100-005, S-HP100-006, S-HP100-007, S-HP100-008, S-HP100-009, S-HP100-010, S-HP100-011, S-HP100-012`. Link: https://rma.internal/rma/8341

liam_logistics: Received the manifest. Quick Q: can vendor set HS code to `8471` on the proforma to reduce reclassification risk? Last time that saved ~48 hrs.

vendor_flux: We'll set HS code `8471.80.00` and include net unit value on proforma. Courier will pre-clear to FRA to reduce hold time.

jess_procure: Approved. mike_ops prioritize staging on Tuesday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
